intended_object: A projection that sends an object of the type-synonym structure `DGHomotopyCategory R C` (the wrapper around objects of C used to put the homotopy category H⁰(C) structure on them) back to the object of C it wraps. Inferred from the docstring and the structure definition at line 542.
explanation: `DGHomotopyCategory R C` is a one-field structure that wraps an object of C. It exists so that the homotopy-category instance (morphisms are DG homotopy classes, i.e. H⁰ of the hom complexes) does not clash with the DG category structure on C. `underlying` just returns that field, `X.obj`, and is the inverse of `of`. Mathematically the homotopy category has the same objects as C, so this map is an identity on objects. It is an implementation detail of the type synonym, a counterpart of `Quotient.as` or `InducedCategory`-style accessors, not a mathematical construction to compare against the literature. It does what its docstring says.
